title: Sources: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, which would create a cybersecurity company with a combined market cap of ~$265B; ZS jumps 15%+ after hours (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler, which would create a cybersecurity company with a combined market cap of ~$265B; ZS jumps 15%+ after hours — CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter …
